title: Keys copy between layers and the playhead lands on them
goal: Last building slice of the user's keyframe ask. Keys copy and paste between layers and moments, the playhead snaps to keys and jumps between them from the keyboard, and a clip's volume keys draw as a level line on its sound that you drag, as in Premiere.
notes: Split out of keyframe-anything-and-see-and-shape-the-keys-on by the manager pass 2026-09-23 06:10. Needs the lanes (a-layer-s-track-opens-into-one-lane-per-keyed-va) and sound segments on the timeline (a-clip-s-sound-is-on-the-timeline-from-the-momen). Keys: the user wrote Shift-K and Option-K. Check them against premiere-s-keys-work-on-the-timeline before binding (Premiere's own next/previous keyframe defaults may differ, and K is part of JKL); if they collide, keep the user's pair and write the collision into the log rather than choosing silently.
acceptance: Copy selected keys, move the playhead or select another layer, paste: the keys land at the playhead on the matching values
Dragging the playhead snaps to keys, and Shift-K and Option-K jump to the next and previous key
Volume keys on a clip show as a level line with points on its sound segment; drag a point up or down to change the level, click the line to add one
Reachable at Next defaults with no flag changed: a walk with no flags copies a title's keys to a second title and dips the volume under it, photographing both; audit written under queue/audits/
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Before building: the mock gives no copy/paste surface for keys, so Premiere's is the target: Edit Copy/Paste take picked keys first (keys picked on lanes are the smaller, more recent thing in hand, same rule as Delete), plus Copy Keys / Paste Keys rows on the key, lane and clip right-click menus. Paste goes onto the picked layer at the playhead, earliest key first, spacing and eases kept; a value the target lacks (text size on a box) is left out. A playhead off the target clip pastes at the clip's nearer end so nothing lands invisible. Volume level points already existed as a line with draggable points and click-to-add on the sound segment, but reproduced two problems in the probe: a point drag wrote an undo step per mouse move (one Cmd-Z only moved it back a sliver) and acted on the PICKED layer's sound rather than the dot's own. Both fixed.

Keys: Shift-K / Option-K as the user wrote. K alone is this app's Lens tool (a one-tool slot, so no Shift-K cycling) and, once premiere-s-keys-work-on-the-timeline lands, Premiere's Stop; the chords do not collide with either. I could not confirm Premiere's own default for Go to Next/Previous Keyframe from here, so kept the user's pair as the task note says. Jump steps across the picked layer's keys (all values and volume points), or every layer when nothing is picked. Snap reach is 8pt on the ruler and bare lanes, to every key on the timeline.

left rough (log only, under the bar or already covered): the dB readout beside a dragged level point is not photographed because a walk cannot hold a window drag mid-air; volume points are not copyable (not on a lane); keys pasted past a clip end are kept but not drawn (Premiere does the same); level dots are accent blue vs the mock's plain mint line; the standing duck -8 dB tag was already left rough by the linked-sound task; a walk's click step goes to the canvas, so taps on the timeline are zero-length windowDrag steps.

Shipped in 1f093261. Command C/V copy picked lane keys onto another layer (or the same one) at the playhead on matching values, spacing and eases kept; Copy/Paste Keys on the key, lane and clip right-click menus. Playhead snaps to keys within 8pt on the ruler and lanes; Shift-K / Option-K go to next/previous key. Sound level line: click adds a point, dragging a point is one undo step on its own layer with a dB readout. Verified: Scripts/test.sh 9464/9464, keys-copy-between-layers-walk at Next defaults with 5 real captures, plus 7 related walks. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-23-keys-copy-between-layers.json.
